architecture.overview: Repository with 162 files across 34 modules. 0 public exports, 0 types, 0 functions.

ai_analysis.pattern: Layered microservice architecture with event-driven components

layers.name: Presentation Layer
layers.purpose: Handle HTTP requests, routing, and real-time communication

layers.name: Business Logic Layer
layers.purpose: Core application logic and component orchestration

layers.name: Infrastructure Layer
layers.purpose: Caching, storage, and cloud service integrations

ai_analysis.data_flow: Requests enter through controllers/routes, flow to business components for processing, interact with models for data operations, communicate with external services via Kafka/SQS, utilize Redis for caching, and AWS services for file storage and workflow management
strengths: Clear separation of concerns with layered architecture
Event-driven architecture with Kafka integration for scalability
Database migration support for schema evolution
weaknesses: High coupling between layers indicated by numerous integration points
Potential redundancy in Redis implementations (shared-redis, redis, redis-sub)
Single large service rather than true microservices decomposition
Mixed responsibilities in some modules (e.g., utils handling multiple concerns)
recommendations: Consider decomposing into smaller, more focused microservices
Consolidate Redis-related modules to reduce complexity
Implement API gateway pattern for better request routing
Add service discovery mechanism for better scalability
Establish clear module boundaries and reduce cross-cutting dependencies
Implement comprehensive monitoring and observability across layers

ai_summary.overview: A comprehensive test management service for LambdaTest platform that handles test execution, device management, and result processing. The service provides APIs for managing test sessions, coordinating with various AWS services, and handling real-time communication through WebSockets.
ai_summary.purpose: To provide a centralized backend service for managing automated testing workflows, device allocation, test result storage, and integration with cloud infrastructure for the LambdaTest testing platform
suggestions: Add more unit tests for better coverage
Implement health check endpoints for monitoring
Consider breaking down larger controller files
Add API rate limiting for better resource management
